text: ツノで　つかれると　がんせきにも　あながあいてしまう。

structure.jp: ツノで　つかれると

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending turns 'to jab' into 'to be jabbed', so the thing named is on the receiving end. つかれる = 'is jabbed'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when this happens, that always follows'. つかれると = 'when it is jabbed'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, with no going back. あいてしまう = 'ends up opening'.
